name: Nucor
outlook:
What Nucor says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: earningsWe expect earnings in the fourth quarter of 2026 to be generally in-line with or modestly higher than the third quarter.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: steel mills segmentIn the steel mills segment, we expect stable earnings due to higher realized pricing offset by seasonally lower volumes and higher costs.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: steel products segmentIn the steel products segment, we expect stable earnings on higher realized pricing and seasonally lower volumes.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: raw materials segmentThe raw materials segment is expected to have slightly lower earnings due to lower realized DRI pricing.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
